text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win...! I want to beat Logo!!
I want to win, I want to win—I don't want to lose!!)

text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text:
(—Then I shall win!! I shall win right now!!
I'll win, I can win! —I MUST WIN!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Woooooooaaaahhhhhhh-!
Aaaaaaaalllllll rrrrrrrrriiiiiiiggggggghhhhhhht!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...?!" "Is that voice... Epi?!"
"Th-This is completely out of control!!"
—"Can she hold out until the very end...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, crap...!" "Should I go now?!"
"...Ngh, no, I can't let her throw off my pace—"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
…………――Don't rush.
Run your own race... at your own pace――!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A complete victory for Logotype!! Once again showing the run of a champion!! The Junior Class champion has conquered the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Alright!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Logo...! Congratulations~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You ran with such confidence, it was amazing...!
To me, you looked brighter than anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Only Logo...
stayed true to his own race.
Such incredible grit in an atmosphere like that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of girl Logo-chan is... Heh. Apparently her family runs a sign shop.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Sign makers? They're still around today! 
I'll look into it a bit more when I get back~."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is the right way after all.
I'll stick to this path—all the way to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Damn it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, Logo!!!
I knew you were strong...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Still, I was amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Their cheers gave me a huge push, and I hope it left a lasting impression on everyone—

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You know... Logo-chan seems pretty cool."
"I think I'll root for her in the Derby too♪"
"...Huh, she's the daughter of a signboard shop owner?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry!
I lost!
choice_data_list: You did great, good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but—
If you don't feel that spark of destiny, then it's no good.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone felt like the logo was destiny!
I really have to produce results...!
choice_data_list: ...Is that really all there is to it?
...Is that really all there is to it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What's that supposed to mean!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Getting results isn't the only way to captivate hearts. Logotype's run today gave it everything she had—it was truly magnificent."
choice_data_list: It seems your perfect run left an impression on everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No!
Just the way you are is fine!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too!
It says keep going, go as far as we can!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I understand what you're saying, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The reality is, Logo got what I wanted. If I stay the way I am now, it's just not going to cut it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then...
what do you think you need to change?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The kind of interest Epiphaneia seeks is so intense that people
"feel destiny" in her. Merely being liked isn't enough; what's needed is—
choice_data_list: You have to stay disciplined when you run.
Make sure you stay disciplined when you run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Right now, she can't hold back her overflowing fighting spirit and is running purely on instinct, but... if she comes to terms with her feelings and claims a flawless victory at the Nippon Derby――"
choice_data_list: I'm sure more girls will start feeling that sense of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's usually one for quick decisions, yet now she's deep in thought...
Honestly, I expected her to answer,
"Even so, I'll run however I please," but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I'll follow your lead!
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Even if it's a different path from the voice of destiny...?
Are you sure? Even if it's a different path from the voice of destiny...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's the right thing to do!
But still—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely want to win the Derby!!
I don't want a repeat of what happened today!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I will never allow such a thing!
I'll win, and make everyone feel destiny at work!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Up until today, I ran while being pushed forward by everyone's voices.
So this time—I'm believing in you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having her follow our instructions instead of the voice of destiny.
I already know full well just how unprecedented that is for her.
choice_data_list: I'll live up to your trust.
I'll live up to your trust.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her primary goal all along, the Japanese Derby...
Her greatest rival isâherself.
